standard-dialogue.text: If the player has not completed Barbarian Training:

steps.npc: Good day to you, hearty warrior! May the spirits guide you.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player has completed Barbarian Training:

steps.npc: Welcome back, friend of the spirits. I am humbled in your presence. You are no longer the apprentice, but the master. Seek to inspire all with your daring deeds and legendary feats.

options.condition: If the player has not completed Barbarian Training:

steps.text: The player talks to Otto about their progress.

options.text: Do you have anything for me?
options.condition: If the player does not have My notes:

steps.player: Do you have anything for me?

steps.npc: I see you have free space and no way to record any information you may recover from the caverns. Please take this book as a record of your researches.

steps.text: My notes

steps.player: What kind of information are you thinking of?

steps.npc: Those who have previously entered the cavern have not all returned. Some of them seemed intent upon research and discovery as much as loot and daring deeds.
It would be a shame if you were to recover any of their notes and be unable to record them handily. I hope the new book will give you space for such discoveries.

options.text: Can you help me with hastae?
options.condition: If the player has a Zamorakian spear, Zamorakian hasta, or broken dragon hasta in their inventory:

steps.player: Can you help me with hastae?

steps.npc: Perhaps. What do you need?

options.text: Can you forge anything from this broken-looking hasta?

steps.player: Can you forge anything from this broken-looking hasta?

steps.text: If the player has not completed the Smithing portion of Barbarian Training:

steps.npc: Yes, I can work with this, but remember, you cannot comprehend how to wield a hasta until you have learned to create one by following my teachings.

steps.text: ~ WARNING ~ You do not have the requirements to wield a hasta!

steps.prompt: Do you wish to make a dragon hasta?

steps.text: If the player has completed the Smithing portion of Barbarian Training:

steps.npc: Yes, I can work with this.

steps.prompt: Do you wish to make a dragon hasta?

steps.text: The player watches Otto smith on an anvil.
Otto has created a dragon hasta.

steps.npc: As you wish.

options.text: Can you convert Zamorakian spears into hastae?

steps.player: Can you convert Zamorakian spears into hastae?

steps.npc: Yes, I can convert a Zamorakian spear into a hasta. The spirits require me to request 300,000 coins from you for this service.

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 300,000 coins:

steps.player: I can't afford that. Maybe another time.

steps.text: If the player has at least 300,000 coins:

steps.prompt: Do you wish to convert your spear?

steps.text: The player watches Otto smith on an anvil.
Otto has converted your spear into a hasta.

steps.npc: As you wish.

options.text: Can you convert Zamorakian hastae into spears?

steps.player: Can you convert Zamorakian hastae into spears?

steps.npc: Yes, I can convert a Zamorakian hasta into a spear. I do not charge for this service.

steps.prompt: Do you wish to convert your hasta?

steps.text: The player watches Otto smith on an anvil.
Otto has converted your hasta into a spear.

steps.npc: As you wish.
As you wish.

options.text: I'd like to smash my pots when planting trees again.
options.condition: If the player has plant pot smashing disabled:

steps.player: I'd like to smash my pots when planting trees again.

steps.npc: Consider it done.

options.text: I'd like to be calmer and not smash my pots.
options.condition: If the player has plant pot smashing enabled:

steps.player: I'd like to be calmer and not smash my pots.

steps.npc: Consider it done.

options.text: Could you tell me more of these spirits you continually refer to?

steps.player: Could you tell me more of these spirits you continually refer to?

steps.npc: Certainly, though it is quite simple - they are the barbarians of the past who have died in the passing of the years. There are three categories which learned sages claim may describe all spirits encountered.
The majority are at peace, having died with their ambitions sated, even if this ambition was as simple as a glorious death. They can contact those in our world in order to spur us on to glory.
Of course, they cannot or will not contact all inhabitants of these lands, for not all are worthy.

steps.player: So those are the spirits who give us guidance. What of the other sorts?

steps.npc: A second category of spirit is made up of those who are not yet at peace. However, all that is needed is for their mortal remains to be laid to rest and they will join the peaceful majority.

steps.player: I can see the pyres serve this purpose. The final category is also restless?

steps.npc: Alas, there is a small minority who will never be at rest. These have been slain in moments of insanity by their brothers or by adventurers.

They are not at rest and will attack those they blame for their tortured state. They are not known, however, for being able to determine this blame with any great accuracy, so should be considered dangerous to all.

steps.player: Thank you Otto. It makes a bit more sense now.

treasure-trails-medium-getting-the-chall.npc: I have further training for you.

treasure-trails-medium-getting-the-chall.text: Otto has given you a challenge scroll!

treasure-trails-medium-solving-the-chall.npc: Please enter the answer to the question.

steps.npc: Wrong! Focus your thoughts.
Correct, you've completed this part of your training.

steps.text: If the player gets another clue:
Otto has given you another clue scroll!
If the player gets a casket:
You've obtained a casket!

treasure-trails-hard-getting-the-challen.npc: I need you to answer this for me.

steps.npc: Nope, Go check again!
Spot on!
